notes: Texts copied from the real cards (sheet 331 of the tournament save, 2026-10-28); where unmatched-memory differs, this file wins. Migrated to DSL v1 (docs/effects-dsl.md) on 2026-10-28 without changing the semantics.
Every damage is effect damage: it is what FATEFUL BARGAINS can divert and Pact Of Mortality raises by 1; combat damage is computed by the engine.
Cards with a Baba Yaga restriction are played by her (this = hero); ANY ones also by Koschei, which is why 'adjacent to Baba Yaga' uses hero and 'your fighter' uses this.
Ivan's decision (28/10): 'takes 2 or more combat damage' is within a single combat; if Bound In Blood diverts the damage to Koschei, Baba Yaga does not take it and the Pact continues.
Ivan's decision (28/10): only one ONGOING can be active per player: playing a new one replaces the active one (it goes to the discard). The Time For Deals Is Done discards that one.
Ivan's decision (28/10): Pact Of Secrecy 'draw up to 2': each player chooses how many (0-2).
Ivan's decision (28/10): Pact Of Mortality 'Return a defeated fighter' applies to any defeated fighter, the rival's too.
Ivan's decision (28/10): Iron Teeth and The Time For Deals Is Done also damage Koschei, as the text says.

ability.text:
FATEFUL BARGAINS
If Baba Yaga and Koschei share a zone and Baba Yaga would take effect damage, you may have Koschei take that damage instead.
ability.notes: Optional passive: while effect damage on Baba Yaga is being resolved, if Koschei shares a zone and is alive, the owner may pass it all to him (it is not split). In the HeroDef it appears as passives[fateful_bargains] effect redirect_effect_damage: same meaning, a single name here.

cards.title: The Time For Deals Is Done
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: If you have an active ongoing scheme, deal 2 damage to each other fighter in Baba Yaga's zone, then discard that scheme.
cards.notes: The damage also reaches Koschei if he shares a zone (it is 'each other fighter'). There is only one active ONGOING per player (Ivan's rule, 28/10): it discards that one.

cards.title: Iron Teeth
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Deal 1 damage to an adjacent fighter. If you have an active ongoing scheme, Baba Yaga recovers 2 health.
cards.notes: Adjacent to Baba Yaga (the card is hers). If there is no adjacent fighter, the damage is not applied and the healing continues.

cards.title: Remove A Painful Memory
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Look at your opponent's hand. If you have an active ongoing scheme, choose one of those cards, then deal 2 damage to the opposing fighter unless they discard it.
cards.notes: ANY restriction: Koschei can also attack with it. It fits in primitives (optional with an else branch decided by the rival); the plan's baba:remove_painful_memory plugin is not needed. If the rival's hand is empty, looking at the hand yields nothing and the rest is not applied (choose with no candidates: the binding stays empty and there is nothing to discard or decide).

cards.title: Death's Release
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Koschei recovers 2 health. Place him in any space.
cards.notes: Only Koschei plays it (attack 5): Koschei is the attacker and is alive when resolving it. Healing does not exceed 3.

cards.title: Read The Bones
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Put one in your hand. Randomly put the rest on the bottom of your deck.
cards.notes: With fewer than 5 cards in the deck, those there are get looked at.

cards.title: Foul Journey
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Place a fighter in the combat in any space. If you have an active ongoing scheme, Baba Yaga recovers 1 health.
cards.notes: The owner chooses which of the two fighters of the combat to place (the rival included) and where.

cards.title: Hasten Towards Death
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Deal 1 damage to the attacking fighter. The attacking player gains 1 action.
cards.notes: Versatile ANY: played as an attack, the attacker itself takes the damage (if it is Baba Yaga, FATEFUL BARGAINS can pass it to Koschei) and its player gains the action; played in defense, both go to the rival. With Pact Of Time active nobody gains the action.

cards.title: Out Of Time
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: You may BOOST this card. AFTER COMBAT: End the turn.
cards.notes: It ends the turn of whoever has it, win or lose the combat: in defense it cuts the rival's turn. Ivan's decision (28/10): the boost comes out of the HAND, like any boost (the used card goes to the discard, public; without a boost value it cannot be used). The card says 'BOOST this card' (not 'this attack'): that is why the engine must not detect it by text but by may_boost.

cards.title: Deathless
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Summon Koschei as close to Baba Yaga as possible. Set his health to 3.
cards.notes: Ivan's decision (28/10): if Koschei is defeated he returns as close as possible to Baba Yaga with 3 life; if alive, he moves as close as possible to her and his life becomes 3 (the card says so).

cards.title: Bound In Blood
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: If Koschei and Baba Yaga share a zone, he takes the combat damage instead.
cards.notes: Defense by Baba Yaga only: she is the defender. It is not optional (unlike the ability). Koschei takes all the combat damage even if it kills him.

cards.title: Pact Of Freedom
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Place a hero in any space. ONGOING: Players cannot attack as their first action each turn. Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.
cards.notes: Ivan's decision (28/10): 'hero' is always the main character; 'fighter' is hero or sidekick. Any hero, own or rival's, is placed, never a sidekick.

cards.title: Pact Of Mortality
cards.text: Return a defeated fighter to any space in Baba Yaga's zone. Set their health to 3. ONGOING: Increase all effect damage by 1, except for damage from exhaustion. Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.
cards.notes: The +1 affects all effect damage of both players (Iron Teeth, Hasten Towards Death, Pact Of Peace, Remove A Painful Memory, The Time For Deals Is Done and the rival's effects), not combat or exhaustion damage. If there is no defeated fighter, the immediate part does nothing.

cards.title: Pact Of Peace
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to each other fighter in Baba Yaga's zone. Gain 1 action. ONGOING: At the end of each turn, deal 1 damage to each hero that attacked. Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.
cards.notes: The immediate damage reaches Koschei if he is in the zone. The end-of-turn damage is effect damage: Pact Of Mortality raises it and, if Baba Yaga takes it, FATEFUL BARGAINS can pass it to Koschei. Only heroes, not sidekicks that attacked.

cards.title: Pact Of Secrecy
cards.text: All players draw up to 2 cards, then shuffle all but 2 cards from their hand into their deck. ONGOING: Players have a maximum hand size of 3. Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.
cards.notes: 'Up to 2' is decided by each player (0, 1 or 2). With 2 or fewer cards in hand the choice is cut down to what there is and nothing is returned. The hand cap of 3 applies when drawing (the maneuver does not go past 3) and at the end of the turn according to the general excess-hand rule.

cards.title: Pact Of Time
cards.text: Each player shuffles up to 2 cards from their discard pile into their deck. ONGOING: Players cannot gain actions. Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.
cards.notes: It blocks 'gains 1 action' of Hasten Towards Death, that of Pact Of Peace and any action gain of the rival (e.g. Hellboy has none, Medusa neither). The two normal actions of the turn are not 'gained'.

hidden_info.bot: The bot only reads the human's hand at that instant (after the combat, with the card already revealed) and keeps all of it in KnownHand; from there it discounts each card the human plays or discards and, when they play face down, knows it is one of the known set until revealed. Cards they draw afterwards are unknown. If there is no active Pact, it only looks and remembers. When the human plays it against the bot, the bot shows its hand (the TTS bridge shows it or announces it in the chat) and decides alone between discarding the chosen card or taking the damage.

hidden_info.info: The top 5 cards of the own deck.
hidden_info.bot: Own deck: the bot looks at the 5 (legitimate, the card says so), keeps one and comes to know that the other 4 are at the bottom as a set, without order (they go at random). It can use that when planning. When the human plays it, the bot only knows that their hand has 1 more card, unknown.

hidden_info.info: What each player draws and which 2 cards they keep.
hidden_info.bot: For the human's hand: after the effect it has exactly 2 cards; if the bot knew part of their hand, KnownHand becomes 'subset of 2 among the known plus the drawn'; the practical thing is to empty KnownHand and keep only the count (2) unless the whole previous hand was known and they drew nothing. The cards returned to the deck are not seen. For itself, the bot chooses how many it draws and which it keeps.

hidden_info.info: None hidden: the discard is public.
hidden_info.bot: The cards each player returns to the deck are chosen from the discard face up, so the bot sees which ones return to the human's deck and updates its model of the rival's deck (and of its own deck). The order after shuffling is unknown.

hidden_info.info: The 2 cards drawn by the owner.
hidden_info.bot: If the human plays it, their hand count goes up 2 and those 2 are unknown; if the bot plays it, nothing is hidden for it.
Only the rival's hand count goes up 1.

hidden_info.info: The boost card leaves Baba Yaga's hand and goes to the discard in plain sight (Ivan's decision, 28/10).
hidden_info.bot: When the human boosts, the bot discounts that card from KnownHand if it had seen it.

hidden_info.card: Deathless, Death's Release, Foul Journey, Iron Teeth, Hasten Towards Death, Bound In Blood, The Time For Deals Is Done, Pact Of Mortality, Pact Of Peace
hidden_info.bot: Everything they touch (life, positions, actions, schemes in play) is public.
